title: LOCALBENCH: Benchmarking LLMs on County-Level Local Knowledge and Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking factual local knowledge and reasoning using socio-economic indicators (Census), local news, and community discourse. While it includes one demographic indicator for religious adherence (Southern Baptist Convention) as a cultural data point, it does not evaluate the models on religious faith, moral values, theology, or ethical principles. The ethical statement provided is a standard disclosure of data sovereignty and not a benchmarking component of the research.
